title: security: rbac v2 enforce KMS region pinning + audit hardening
author: Ayesha Khan
description: Motivation: Enforce RBAC-v2 KMS region pinning and improve audit logging for data residency requirements. Customers have asked for stronger guards that prevent cross-region KMS usage and provide clearer audit trails for key selection decisions. This change implements enforcement in the RBAC v2 policy enforcer, surfaces KMS region constraints at the policy layer, and hardens audit logs to include residency decision details. Summary of changes: 1) policy enforcer: new enforcement path for kms.regionPin property and validation against org & project residency settings; 2) KMS integration: region-aware key resolver and explicit failure modes when a requested key is out-of-region; 3) audit logging: add residency_decision, requested_key_region, resolved_key_region, policy_match_id to audit payloads; 4) migration: DB migration to add kms_region_pin bool and policy_match_id index for fast queries; 5) rollout: feature-flag gated (rbac_v2_kms_pin_enforce) with a canary rollout to 5% then 50% before full rollout; 6) docs & CLI: docs update and CLI validator added. Checklist: - [x] Design review (SEC/Infra) - [x] Unit & integration tests - [x] Migration script and rollback - [x] Canary rollout plan - [x] Update docs and SDK compatibility notes Testing: unit tests added for policy evaluation and audit payload shape; integration job exercises cross-region key resolution and ensures correct failure/retry semantics; manual canary in staging for 48h with synthetic traffic. Rollout notes: enable feature flag for internal teams first, monitor audit logs for increased policy_match_id patterns and KMS errors. If rollout spikes errors >2x baseline for 5m, auto rollback the flag. Related: ENG-4921, SUP-2108. Release notes included below.
commits: feat(rbac): add kms.regionPin enforcement path in policy enforcer
feat(kms): region-aware key resolver + explicit region mismatch error
chore(audit): attach residency_decision + policy_match_id to audit events
db(migration): add kms_region_pin column and policy_match_id index
docs: add kms region pinning docs and rollout guidance
test: add unit/integration tests for enforcement and audit payloads
review_comments: Liam O'Connor: Please confirm the expected behavior for existing keys that are global (e.g., legacy keys) — should we allow a migration window?

Ayesha Khan: We added a migration window and the feature-flag prevents enforcement until migration completed. Legacy global keys are allowed when project-level residency is unset; otherwise enforcement blocks and returns 403 with KMS_REGION_MISMATCH.
Priya Patel: Audit payload looks good, can you include a compact policy_match_id to avoid very large strings in logs?
Ayesha Khan: Switched to SHA256 truncated to 12 chars for policy_match_id; updated migration and audit tests.
Diego Morales: CI had a transient failure on e2e-private-installer; re-ran and it passed. Approving post-green.
Liam O'Connor: A few nits on doc wording and CLI error codes; addressed in follow-up commit.

release_notes: Enforce RBAC v2 KMS region pinning and harden audit logging: introduces a feature-flag (rbac_v2_kms_pin_enforce) to gate enforcement, adds audit fields to record residency decisions, and provides migration/rollback steps. Admins should review KMS key residency and run the provided migration. See docs/security/kms-region-pinning.md for full guidance.
regressions_tested: end-to-end private deployment with key-residency enabled
notes: Operationally sensitive change; SRE and Security on-call were included in rollout. DB migration is additive and reversible. Monitored metrics: rbac.enforcer.denied.kms_region_mismatch, audit.event.size, kms.client.errors. Backout plan: disable rbac_v2_kms_pin_enforce and run migration rollback script.
